title: Correct output power
description: Essential: The final expression for the transformer's output power P must be correctly derived as U_m^2/(50R).

title: Correct heating time
description: Essential: The final expression for the required time t must be correctly derived as 50 C T_0 R / U_m^2.

title: Transformer voltage scaling
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the turns ratio to relate primary and secondary voltages, using RMS values.

title: Gas process analysis
description: Important: The solution must identify the heating as an isochoric process and correctly relate the doubled pressure to a doubled temperature.

title: Energy balance setup
description: Important: The solution must equate the electrical energy delivered (P*t) to the heat absorbed by the gas (CΔT).

title: RMS voltage conversion
description: Optional: The solution correctly converts the given peak supply voltage U_m to its RMS value.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final answers for power and time have correct and consistent units.

title: Incorrect process assumption
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly assumes an isobaric or other process, leading to a wrong ΔT.

title: Peak vs. RMS error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if power is calculated using the peak voltage U_m directly without converting to RMS.
